mapper.select: SELECT r.role_key FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND r.status = 1

SELECT DISTINCT m.perms FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON rm.role_id = ur.role_id JOIN sys_menu m ON m.id = rm.menu_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND m.status = 1 AND m.perms IS NOT NULL
